column4: ~/proj/prompts/reports/SESSION-REVIEW-LEAVES-1.md item 4. Finding BESTEFFORT-LOG-LINE-FORGE (low, fixed): the failure and SECURITY: panic log lines printed the error/panic value raw, so embedded newlines forged extra log lines; now quoted (internal/besteffort/review_leaves_test.go:TestRun_FailureLogIsOneLine, red on main). Contract holds and is now pinned for an Error method that panics (returned and panicked), a typed-nil error and panic(nil) (:TestRun_HostileValues_NeverEscape, red under a recordFailure-calls-err.Error() mutation). Every call site passes a literal step name (bounded metric cardinality, no data in labels); every RunRecover is deferred directly by the goroutine closure, so recover() is effective. Not covered: runtime.Goexit or os.Exit inside fn (not recoverable by design)
